thread:
Priya: quick flag — Kite-v3 (PTQ int8) canary popped structured-output parse failures on funcalls. sample=2500, fails=172 => 6.88% vs fp16 mirror 5/2500 => 0.20%. dropping a couple of representative traces below.

Eli: link pls :eyes:

Priya: pasted minimal repros:
```
REQ: {"prompt":"invoke get_profile id=88", "function_call": {"name":"get_profile"}}
STREAMED RESP SNIP: ...\"function_call\":{\"name\":\"get_profile\",\"arguments\":\"{\\\"id\\\":88,\\\"fields\\\":[\\\"email\\\"]}\"}...
```
and a truncation case:
```
...\"function_call\":{\"name\":\"get_profile\",\"arguments\":{\"id\":88,\"meta\":{\"tags\":[\"a\",\"b\"]
```
(missing closing braces). also saw NDJSON streams with blank line separators (empty object parse errors).

Noah: pattern = double-escaped JSON-string for arguments OR object with truncated suffix. any canary-specific config?

Priya: canary temp=0.6 for diversity. avg toolcall token_len int8 +9% vs fp16. streaming last_token often not a brace => likely cutoff at stream boundary.

Eli: mitigation candidates: (1) ship canary-only tolerant "rescue" parser: if arguments is string -> attempt JSON.parse(inner); apply tiny fixes (strip trailing commas, escape raw newlines, ignore empty NDJSON lines). attach telemetry: original_text, rescue_steps, rescue_applied=true/false. (2) one mirrored fp16 retry if rescue fails. (3) add small goldens stressing nested arrays/long args to canary; (4) fuzzer that injects double-escaped, trailing commas, blank-lines.

Noah: +1 to rescue parser in canary. ensure we record whether semantics changed (attach original vs repaired). avoid auto-muting fields silently.

ci-bot: ci-bot: created ticket INF-2026-114 (assignees: eng-ml, TokenizerTeam) "Kite-v3 int8 funcall parse regression"

Perf-bot: perf-bot: queued micro-bench job kite-v3-int8 vs fp16 structured-output 1000 prompts (measure parse_fail, token_count, cutoff_count, latency).

Eli: runner notes — prefer cheap heuristic repairs first, then single fp16 retry. retry budget is limited. telemetry should capture token_delta when rescue runs (cost impact).

Priya: I'll open a small PR for lib/parse/rescue with unit tests for: double-escaped JSON, trailing commas, NDJSON blank-lines, truncated-suffix patching (add closing braces heuristically only when safe). tagging @Eli @Noah for review.

Noah: I'll add the harness fuzzer and run the micro-bench tonight. if post-rescue fail >1% we pin to fp16 and block rollout.

Eli: also check recent tokenizer/kernel patches last week — pinging @TokenizerTeam to confirm no streaming change.

TokenizerTeam: noted — we'll diff the tokenizer release and kernel tiling commits and report any changes that could affect token boundaries.

Priya: thanks all. will update the ticket w/ PR and bench results. keeping canary pinned until we confirm. :mag:
